Description.Name: 历史
Description.Details:
很久以前，你常读那些很久以前的故事。
特性：[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkBookish]  书呆子]]、[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[QuirkLosTech]  失落科技经验]]

OptionDescription:
你曾是你家族中大有前途的年轻继承人，却犯下了不可饶恕的过错，被判终身流放。

你带着家族祖传的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAncestralBlackjack]  黑杰克]]偷偷离开，出发去寻找属于自己的新生活。

+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorGunnery]  射击]]，+1 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[StatMechWarriorTactics]  战术]]
BioDescription: You have ever been looking to the past, perhaps to a fault. Any period of history, be it pre-spaceflight or as recent as the Age of War, has always piqued your interest. Despite not having a formal education in the field, your knowledge of some eras rivals even the most accredited historians.
